About the Role:

You'll work alongside diverse, cross-border teams and supportive colleagues who share knowledge and want to see you succeed. We are seeking a highly strategic and hands-on Head of Finance to lead financial planning, corporate finance, treasury, and strategic initiatives for a growing organization. This individual will serve as a key partner to executive leadership and investors, providing the financial insight, forecasting, and analysis needed to support growth, operational improvement, M&A activity, and ultimately a successful liquidity event. The role will also champion AI and workflow efficiency, modernizing how Finance operates to speed up planning and reporting and free the team to focus on higher-value analysis.

The ideal candidate has operated in a Private Equity-backed or Investment Banking environment and has personally helped lead a company through an exit transaction. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between high-level strategic finance and hands-on execution.

Your Impact:

Strategic Finance & FP&A

• Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and financial modeling processes.

• Partner with executive leadership to evaluate business performance, growth opportunities, investment decisions, and strategic initiatives.

• Develop KPI reporting and management dashboards that provide actionable insight into revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and operating performance.

• Build sophisticated financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to support executive and Board-level decision-making.

M&A & Transaction Support

• Play a leadership role in evaluating potential acquisitions, investments, partnerships, and other strategic transactions.

• Lead financial modeling, valuation analysis, financial due diligence, and transaction-related analysis.

• Partner with executives, investors, investment bankers, attorneys, and other external advisors throughout transaction processes.

• Support acquisition integration, synergy tracking, and post-close performance measurement.

• Help position the organization for a future strategic or private equity exit, including financial preparation, diligence readiness, management presentations, and transaction execution.

• Build and maintain the exit-ready financial package, including KPI definitions, quality of earnings support, and a defensible Adjusted EBITDA bridge with documented add-backs.

Corporate Finance & Treasury

• Oversee cash flow forecasting, liquidity management, capital planning, and treasury activities.

• Evaluate capital structure, financing alternatives, debt requirements, and working capital opportunities.

• Maintain strong relationships with banking and financing partners.

• Partner with Accounting to ensure financial results and underlying data support accurate forecasting and strategic decision-making.

Process Improvement & Finance Transformation

• Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting, forecasting, systems, controls, and overall finance processes.

• Drive automation and standardization across FP&A and corporate finance activities.

• Establish scalable finance processes capable of supporting continued growth and increased organizational complexity.

• Identify, prioritize, and deploy AI and automation use cases across FP&A and corporate finance, such as variance commentary, forecasting, scenario modeling, board and lender reporting, and diligence data requests.

• Redesign finance workflows end to end to remove manual steps, shorten close, forecasting, and reporting cycle times, and reduce error risk; set baselines and track the efficiency gains.

• Establish a single source of truth for financial and operating data, with standardized metric definitions, documented reconciliations, and model governance standards (version control, review and sign-off, audit trails).

Your Qualifications:

• 10+ years of progressive experience across FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, transaction advisory, or related disciplines, including meaningful leadership experience.

• Demonstrated experience leading or playing a significant leadership role in a successful company exit, ideally involving the sale of a private equity-backed company to a strategic or financial buyer.

• Strong M&A experience, including financial modeling, valuation, due diligence, transaction execution, and/or post-acquisition integration.

• Experience operating within a private equity-backed organization is a must-have.

• Demonstrated expertise in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, cash flow modeling, and executive-level financial analysis.

• Strong understanding of treasury, liquidity management, capital structure, debt, and working capital.

• Proven success implementing finance process improvements, automation, AI-enabled workflow efficiency, reporting enhancements, and scalable financial infrastructure.

• Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Hands-on experience applying AI and automation to finance workflows to reduce manual effort and shorten reporting and forecasting cycles, with sound controls over AI-assisted work.

• Demonstrated data governance discipline, including metric definitions, reconciliation controls, model audit trails, and documented ownership of key data.

• Proven people leader who has managed managers or senior analysts and developed a team through a period of change.

• Experience communicating complex financial information to executive leadership, Boards, investors, lenders, and other sophisticated stakeholders.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related discipline required

About The Role
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.
Your Mission

• Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
• 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
• Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
• Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
• Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
• AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
• Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
• Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
• Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.

Your Profile

• 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
• AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
• Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
• Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
• Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
• Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
• Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.
Nice to Have

• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
• Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
• Early-stage startup background.
• Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
• Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.

Why Join Vivid?

• We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
• We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
• AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
• Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
• Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
• Sports compensation. 
• Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.

Compensation range
Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.
